results.title: My first game jam (with an intro to Godot)
results.snippet: Whilst watching random YouTube I stumbled upon this video, a short tutorial for building a 2D platformer in Godot. Now, my husband and I have been joking for a while about one day making 'an indie game' – it ticks off all the creative and technical hobbies we have, from programming to music, art, design and everything in between.
